answer: Here is one concrete wall: Ruby polisher cut stone proof witnessed by the bead record. It works because each cut stone is a decade of logged cut stones plus a signed guild record, so a farm must polish a hundred real rubies by hand, and the hollow it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the pulse is that the farm's unit economics never work. The terrace is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
